description: One volume, as one run measured it.

committed.description: The bytes already committed to landing here.

free.description: Bytes free, or nothing where the volume could not be read.

limit.description:
The effective limit — the mount's own size, which on a dataset given a
quota is the quota rather than the device beneath it.

point.description: Where the volume holding it is mounted, which is what the limit belongs to.

projected.description: What would be free once the committed content has landed.

role.description: Which of the two this is.
